name: Egyptian papyrus writing support
description: Layered plant pith formed a durable writing surface in sheets and rolls; a blank roll survives from a First Dynasty tomb.

date.label: Approximately 2900 BCE
date.basis: The stated range or year applies to the described evidence or documentary event; it does not establish invention.

events.statement: The museum reports an approximately 2900 BCE blank papyrus roll from the tomb of Hemaka and describes layered pith sheets.
